notes: v1.0.37 replaces the v1.0.36 hand-coded SVG-path approximation with a TRUE 1:1 raster->vector trace of the brand image. branding/png/wordmark-master.png is fed through vtracer (a real raster->vector converter) and the resulting paths become the canonical source of truth. scripts/build_icon.py is reduced to a renderer; all hand-coded S_PHOSPHOR_BARS / S_DARK_FOLD / A_OUTLINE polygon lists are gone. Pixel-diff of the rendered vectorization vs the source raster: 98.59% match within +/-24/255 channel tolerance, 99.66% within +/-64/255. Light-mode variants are produced by SVG-text recolor (#FFFFFF -> #1A1C1F for A's) BEFORE rasterization. Product naming: tauri.conf.json productName 'ASA Terminal' -> 'ASA' (window title + installer filename now drop the 'Terminal' suffix; bundle identifier com.asasystems.terminal stays unchanged for auto-updater compat). No functional changes for the trading engine. v1.0.36 -> v1.0.37 auto-updates cleanly because the Tauri identifier is unchanged.
